top1.title: 【2026-10-27】SpaceX、Apolloと約400億ドルのAI向けGPU設備資金調達で合意
top1.lead1: SpaceXは、AI用GPUと関連設備について約400億ドルの資金調達契約で合意したと開示しました。
top1.lead2: Apollo傘下の事業体が設備を購入してリースする仕組みで、条件充足を経て年内の取引完了を見込んでいます。

top10.title: [2026-10-27] SpaceX reaches agreement with Apollo on roughly $40 billion in financing for AI GPU equipment
top10.summary: Under the agreement, an Apollo-affiliated entity will purchase GPUs and other equipment and lease them to SpaceX. The transaction is expected to close by year-end, with leasing expected to begin in the first half of 2027.

top10.title: [2026-10-27] [Analysis] Anthropic's listing application reveals Claude's enterprise customer retention strategy
top10.summary: More than half of customers spending at least $100,000 annually use both the Claude platform and their own applications. TechCrunch examines the cross-product strategy and risks including customer concentration.

top10.title: [2026-10-27] Microsoft offers voluntary departures to up to 60,000 employees, including in AI divisions
top10.summary: Up to 60,000 employees in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and India are eligible. According to The Verge, Copilot and CoreAI are among the divisions included, while some divisions are excluded. The number of employees who will leave has not been determined.

top10.title: [2026-10-27] The RealReal strengthens measures against AI agents holding items for extended periods
top10.summary: Meta's Muse was found capable of repeatedly adding items to carts to prevent other customers from buying them. The RealReal updated its anti-bot measures and restricted automated purchasing actions.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
